answer: Treat standing as a purchasable seat on a bonding curve rather than a free name. A newcomer must buy one seat from an existing holder; each sale prices the next seat at 2.5x the last, and a holder may sell at most one seat per epoch. The seller's 800 POA bond stays liable for the buyer for 20 epochs, so selling to a fake burns the seller too. A farm buying 30 seats pays roughly 2.5^30 times the first price and must find 30 distinct sellers. The quill price log, ledge liability window and grove of seller records make every transfer auditable.
